answer: Paired-receipt bond: each identity locks 70 and files one pair: a haven-yard timber receipt and a haven-orchard nectar report, key-bound to one epoch. Haven auditors cross-check the pair; a mismatched or reused receipt burns the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 timber receipts at 45 plus 1,000 nectar reports at 20: 65,000 against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents file one pair, pay 65, reclaim 70. Rented pairs carry the seller's key.
